claims.text: EventSourcedOrder.LoadedVersion is Version minus the number of new events recorded since the load; after replay with no new events it equals Version.
InMemoryEventStore.Save calls Append(order.Id, order.LoadedVersion, order.NewEvents), then order.MarkSaved(), which clears the new events; if Append throws, MarkSaved is not reached.

Append throws StreamConcurrencyException when stream.Count != expectedVersion; the check comes before stream.AddRange and all.AddRange, so a refused append adds no event to the stream or to the all list.
A stream's version equals its event count: Apply ends with Version++ for every event, and replay applies each stored event once to an order starting at Version 0.
Cancel() passes for a paid order (it refuses only cancelled or shipped) and Ship() requires paid; both call Record, which applies the event, so Version becomes 3 and LoadedVersion stays 2.

In TwoWriters_SecondAppendIsRefused_AndRetryMeetsTheRule, Place and Pay then Save put the stream at version 2; writerA and writerB both Load(5); A's Cancel saves; B's Save throws StreamConcurrencyException; ReadStream(5).Count is 3; Load(5).Ship throws InvalidOperationException.
At stage-2, Order.Version is mapped to PostgreSQL's xmin system column with IsRowVersion(), through the Npgsql EF Core provider.

claims.text: Apply checks no rule, so a stream placed, paid, cancelled, shipped would replay to Status shipped (the last event sets it).
Calling Append(5, 3, writerB.NewEvents) after the refusal would pass the check (the stream holds 3 events) and append OrderShipped after OrderCancelled.

claims.text: The sample store has no lock: Load and Save take nothing and hold nothing between calls; the only concurrency check is the version comparison in Append.
When an append is refused, reload the stream and call the method again rather than re-appending the same event at the new version, because the event was decided against the old state.

StreamConcurrencyException's message is 'order {orderId}: expected version {expectedVersion}, but the stream is at version {actualVersion}'.
